sections.Profile:
Flipper Football , released by Capcom in 1996, is a six-player solid-state soccer game designed by Bryan Hansen and Python Anghelo, with artwork by Hugh Van Zanten. Its dot-matrix display sits beneath the playfield glass, where shots at drop targets send a virtual ball toward the goalkeeper, and Capcom built 750.
